NORTHSTAR FIELD SYSTEMS LTD.
18 September 2026

Dear Morgan Ellis,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Junior Operations Analyst at Northstar Field Systems Ltd. Your annual gross salary will be USD 54,000, paid monthly, and your anticipated start date is 12 October 2026. You will report to the Operations Manager at our Cambridge office.

Your first three months will be a probationary period. The company will provide the equipment required for your role. Approved travel for the pre-employment medical assessment and the assessment fee will be paid directly by Northstar; no payment is requested from you.

Please review the attached employee handbook and return the signed acceptance form to hr@northstar-field.example by 25 September 2026. Your employment terms are subject to the standard reference check described in the handbook.

Sincerely,
Helen Carter
People Operations Manager
Northstar Field Systems Ltd.

CEDARLINE SOFTWARE COMPANY
Offer of Employment

Dear Avery Brooks,

Cedarline Software Company is pleased to offer you full-time employment as a Software Test Engineer, based in Bristol. Your annual salary will be GBP 42,500, paid monthly through the company payroll. Your proposed start date is 5 October 2026.

You will design and run automated tests, document defects, and work with the product engineering team during normal business hours. You will report to Daniel Reed, Test Engineering Lead. The company provides a laptop and the software access needed for your duties.

Please sign and return this letter by 24 September 2026. Questions about this offer may be sent to people@cedarline.example or raised through the careers portal where you submitted your application.

This offer is conditional on verification of your employment references. The detailed leave and benefits terms are in the enclosed policy.

Regards,
Priya Shah
Director of People
Cedarline Software Company

22 September 2026

Dear Jamie Patel,

We are happy to offer you the role of Graduate Service Designer at Bright Harbor Design Studio in Leeds. The position is full time with an annual salary of GBP 31,800. You will join the Customer Experience group and report to Senior Designer Rowan Miller.

Your expected start date is 19 October 2026. During the first six months, you will take part in our regular design review sessions and receive mentoring from the team. Standard working hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Please return the signed acceptance form to careers@brightharbor.example by 2 October 2026. You may contact our People team using the address shown in the application portal if you would like to discuss the position or benefits.

We look forward to welcoming you.

Yours sincerely,
Leah Thompson
People Partner
Bright Harbor Design Studio

MERIDIAN BIOANALYTICS PLC
Employment Offer

Dear Taylor Nguyen,

Meridian BioAnalytics PLC offers you the position of Laboratory Data Coordinator at our Oxford facility. Your annual salary will be GBP 38,200, with benefits described in the attached schedule. The planned start date is 12 October 2026, subject to your acceptance and routine reference checks.

The role includes maintaining sample records, preparing weekly data summaries, and coordinating with laboratory staff. You will report to Dr. Nia Foster, Laboratory Operations Manager.

For employees relocating to Oxford, Meridian can arrange temporary accommodation and reimburse approved rail travel under its standard relocation policy. These costs are paid by the company after receipts are submitted through the employee portal; no advance payment is requested from the candidate.

Please return the signed letter to people@meridianbio.example by 30 September 2026.

Kind regards,
Dr. Nia Foster
Laboratory Operations Manager
Meridian BioAnalytics PLC

24 September 2026

Dear Casey Morgan,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Accounts Assistant at Willow & Finch Accounting, Manchester. Your salary will be GBP 29,400 per year, paid monthly. You will work with the client accounts team and report to Finance Manager Ellis Grant.

Your duties include reconciling invoices, maintaining ledgers, and supporting month-end reporting. Your normal hours will be 37.5 per week. Your proposed start date is 19 October 2026.

After you accept, our People team will provide access to the authenticated employee portal for routine payroll and tax onboarding. Please do not email financial documents or account credentials. No fee is charged to candidates at any stage of recruitment.

Please sign and return the attached letter to recruitment@willowfinch.example by 1 October 2026.

Sincerely,
Ellis Grant
Finance Manager
Willow & Finch Accounting

Amira Lewis
Support Supervisor
